content.comment_body: I am using a [product_name] (version [version_no]) connected to AWS cloud. I created a webpage using [product_name] and would like to show whether the device is online or not. Is there a way to achieve this? I initially considered displaying the latest timestamp, but I am unable to locate that option.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for a solution to show the online/offline status of a [product_name] ([version_no]) on a custom website built with [product_name], with the device connected to AWS cloud. There appears to be no straightforward method within the software to track or display device connectivity status or last communication timestamp, which can lead to uncertainty during operation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an easy option to monitor and visually display the real-time online status or latest communication timestamp of the [product_name] through [product_name].
